analyticalQuestion: What are the exact higher incidence strata of the fixed-first-harmonic 1:2:3 family, and how do two explicit normalized heat paths realize A2 and symmetry-restricted A3 critical-point collisions?
supportedTakeaway: The incidence preimage stops at A5 and is restricted miniversal modulo constants. One exact heat path has 4/3/2 distinct critical points across a unique A2 fold, while a real-even path with active third carrier has 4/2/2 across an A3 collision. The plotted branches are direct samples of proved formulas.
analyticClaims: The A4/A5 closure projects to (15A)^2+(5B)^2=1; its two B=0 endpoints are A5 and all other points correspond to A4 preimages.
The coefficient-derivative jet of orders one through four has determinant 5400, giving restricted miniversality modulo additive constants through A5.
For z20=4i and z30=0, the full y>=0 heat path has one A2 event at y=log(2), with distinct critical-point sequence 4/3/2 and local squared displacement per time increment -2.
For a0=-2563/1280 and b0=1/30, the real-even heat path has an A3 event at y=log(2), with distinct critical-point sequence 4/2/2 and local squared displacement per time increment -6.
Both crossing-time counts remain four when multiplicity is used.

panelClaims.A: Exact projection of the A4/A5 incidence spine in the (A,B) parameters; this is not the global caustic image.
panelClaims.B: Exact A2 colliding branches and their leading square-root law; the noncolliding simple pair is omitted from the local panel but included in the global counts.
panelClaims.C: Exact real-even A3 off-axis branches, the persistent symmetry axis at phi=0, and the leading square-root law; the simple phi=pi branch lies outside the local window but is included in the global counts.

finiteOnlyPolicy: Binary64 grids are used only to draw exact analytic formulas. They do not discover, fit, or certify a root count and cannot replace the continuous proof or dual exact audit.
renderPolicy: The archive contains vector PDF and SVG, a 600 dpi PNG, source data, command, environment, checksums, final-size QA, grayscale QA, and a PDF raster check.
claimBoundary: The figure classifies incidence preimages by vanishing order, not the complete four-dimensional caustic image, its self-intersections, multisingularities, complement chambers, or real A_{2j+1}^{+/-} signs. The A3 path is transverse only inside the real-even two-dimensional slice. It proves no enhanced dissipation through a collision, treats no arbitrary time-dependent phases, supplies no general third-carrier theorem, and implies no general three-dimensional Navier--Stokes regularity. Arnol'd's prior caustic and trigonometric-polynomial topology are not claimed as new.
